$schemaComment: Single source of truth for Grid env-var docs. Edit this file, then run: npm run sync:config

sections.title: Paths & process
sections.intro: Core process paths. Install Compose uses defaults inside the container; override only when you know the layout.

vars.name: PORT
vars.purpose: API listen port (inside the process / container)

vars.name: GRID_HTTP_PORT
vars.purpose: Host port published by Compose for the UI/proxy

vars.name: GRID_CORS_ORIGIN
vars.purpose: Optional CORS allow-list (comma-separated origins). Empty = library default

sections.title: Auth
sections.intro: Bootstrap creates one superadmin. Change the password before any shared host.

vars.name: GRID_AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD
vars.purpose: Bootstrap superadmin password (no placeholders). Keep in sync after `grid admin superadmin` rotates it

vars.name: GRID_AUTH_ADMIN_NAME
vars.purpose: Optional display name for the bootstrap user

vars.name: GRID_AUTH_ALLOW_REGISTER
vars.purpose: Public self-register (`true`/`1`). Keep off for self-host

vars.name: GRID_AUTH_DISABLED
vars.purpose: Bypass auth — **dev only**, never on a public VM

sections.title: GitOps (desired-state sync)
sections.intro: When `GRID_GITOPS_REPO_URL` is set, Core clones/pulls into `GRID_CONFIG_ROOT`. Admins can also change settings in the console (Sources).

vars.name: GRID_GITOPS_REPO_URL
vars.purpose: Remote desired-state repo (fork of grid-config or your own)

vars.name: GRID_GITOPS_PATH
vars.purpose: Optional subdirectory under the clone (relative, no `..`)

vars.name: GRID_GITOPS_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC
vars.purpose: Auto pull + reconcile interval. Default `600` when a repo URL is set; `0` = manual only

vars.name: GRID_USE_DEMO
vars.purpose: Force demo-infra fixture path (local labs). Do not use in production

sections.title: Module bank
sections.intro: Terraform modules consumed by generate. Prefer a **release tag**, not `main`.

vars.name: GRID_MODULE_BANK
vars.purpose: Module bank git URL or local path

vars.name: GRID_MODULE_BANK_REF
vars.purpose: Branch or tag for the module bank

vars.name: GRID_MODULE_BANK_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC
vars.purpose: Auto-refresh local module-bank checkout (seconds). `0` = manual. Default `20` when unset

vars.name: GRID_MODULE_SOURCE
vars.purpose: Optional: force `remote` module sources in generated HCL

sections.title: Remote Terraform state
sections.intro: Required for production / install. Create the store before the first apply — see [Remote state](./Remote_State.md). The same bucket also stores the generated archive mirror.

vars.name: GRID_TF_STATE_BUCKET
vars.purpose: Bucket / container name (s3, gcs, oci, oss, cos, s3compat)

vars.name: GRID_TF_STATE_REGION
vars.purpose: Region for S3 / OSS / COS / s3compat

vars.name: GRID_TF_S3_ENDPOINT
vars.purpose: S3-compatible endpoint (OCI, Huawei OBS, Aliyun OSS, MinIO, …)

vars.name: GRID_TF_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
vars.purpose: Force path-style S3 addressing when the vendor requires it

sections.title: Monitoring
sections.intro: Prometheus + Alertmanager run on the **host** (systemd or local binaries), not inside Grid Compose. Required for production boot. See [Monitoring](./Monitoring.md).

vars.name: GRID_MONITORING_CONFIG_DIR
vars.purpose: Dir for alert `rules/` + `alertmanager.yml` written by the API

vars.name: GRID_MONITORING_HOST_DIR
vars.purpose: Host path bind-mounted for Compose → systemd Prometheus config

sections.title: Argo CD / OpenShift GitOps
sections.intro: Optional Kubernetes workload reconciler (Application CRD). Off by default.

vars.name: GRID_ARGO_KUBECONFIG
vars.purpose: kubeconfig for the cluster where Argo runs (falls back to `KUBECONFIG`)

sections.title: Install / Compose pins
sections.intro: Used by `install/.env` and Compose. Not all apply to a bare `npm run prod` on a local machine.

vars.name: GRID_RELEASE_CHANNEL
vars.purpose: GHCR channel when using release Compose (`current` or `lts`)

vars.name: GRID_CLI_REF
vars.purpose: Git ref when building CLI into the core image from source

vars.name: GRID_UI_REF
vars.purpose: Git ref when building the UI image from source

vars.name: TERRAFORM_VERSION
vars.purpose: Terraform version baked into the core image

sections.title: Console (grid-ui)
sections.intro: Build-time Vite env. Production builds refuse to proceed without `VITE_GRID_API_URL`.

vars.name: VITE_GRID_API_URL
vars.purpose: Browser → API base path or absolute URL
